title: Your starting pad
caption: Each team starts here with a sapling, a water bucket and a lava bucket.

title: A random drop every 30 seconds
caption: You get a random item every 30 seconds. The HUD shows the next drop and the next tier.

title: Automate with Create
caption: A water wheel running a press and a millstone.

title: The neutral market
caption: The market between the two bases has a villager shop, a kitchen, a workshop and a shared chest.

title: Chance Cubes
caption: Chance Cubes are sold at the market and start dropping at tier 3.

title: Landmark islands
caption: One of the bigger landmark islands. These have their own loot.

title: Sky caches
caption: A sky cache opens two minutes after it appears. The first team to open it keeps the loot.
